source_issue.title: Trigger 6-dev documentation build on every push to master in Volto

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue focuses on automating the documentation build process for Plone's Volto project. The goal is to ensure that the documentation is updated every time there’s a push to the master branch. This will help keep the documentation in sync with the latest code changes.

## What needs to be done
The main task is to implement a way to trigger the documentation build automatically on each push to the master branch. The discussion has not led to a clear solution yet, and there are indications that it might be complex. 

## Helpful background
Past discussions have pointed out that similar issues have been raised before in the Plone documentation repository (see issues #1188 and #1214). Although this feature is deemed important, there is uncertainty regarding the feasibility and method of implementation.

## Good first steps
1. **Familiarize yourself** with the existing documentation process for Volto.
2. **Review comments** from contributors for insights on past attempts and current challenges.
3. **Coordinate with the assignee** ([@esteele](https://github.com/esteele)) and others in the thread to understand their perspectives and any ongoing work.
4. Consider researching existing CI/CD tools that automate documentation builds to see if they can fit into this context.

Feel free to ask questions or seek clarification—everyone in the community is here to help!
```
